name: Blowing Dust
body:
School transmutation; Level cleric/oracle 0, druid 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range close (25 ft. + 5 ft./2 levels)
Target one creature
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

Dust and/or sand around the target is kicked up and swirls around their face. Any creatures the target attempts to attack have total concealment (50% miss chance) for 1 round.
